title: POLARIS：引导小模型撰写长篇小说
summary: POLARIS 是一种低计算量的 GRPO 训练方法，结合前沿 LLM 裁判奖励和人类参考注入，使 9B 小模型在长故事写作中与 27B 模型性能相当，并展现出长度泛化能力。
summary_en: POLARIS is a low-compute GRPO recipe combining frontier LLM judge rewards and human-reference injection, enabling a 9B model to match 27B models in long-form story writing while demonstrating length generalization.
